title: RIE Knowledge Graph Provenance Attachment Contract
description: Formal contract governing cryptographic provenance attachments for relational edges and nodes.

provenance_source.description: Canonical path or URI to the source evidence file.

evidence_reference.description: Specific line, section, page, or table offset within the source container.

sha256_hash.description: Exact 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the physical source file.

confidence_score.description: Epistemic confidence rating of the evidentiary attachment.

creation_authority.description: Designated authority level or steward responsible for generating the record.

approval_reference.description: Formal governance decision reference authorizing creation (e.g., DEC-080-KG-CORE).
